description:
## Goal

Replace whole-root backend assembly scans with exact shared contributions so root packaging work is proportional to changed executable, wrapper, atom, and reachable-schema membership.

## Current defect

At HEAD 2f91336cd, backend members and typed body references are already immutable and shared. Root production still traverses all reached backends on each evaluation, aggregates callable owners through union_boxed, globally sorts inventories, reconstructs dense lookup maps, re-extracts atoms, and unions/clones reachable schemas. Struct membership already comes from reached materialized backends and exact StructDefined facts; there is no whole-World schema snapshot to fix. The root MaterializedTransportPlan is proven unused by production consumers; only tests inspect it.

The older 262 ms last-request bracket is only a historical diagnostic lead, not current isolated attribution. Acceptance uses exact work, dependencies, generations and allocations.

## Strategy

1. After transport population pruning, expose immutable keyed executable/wrapper contributions and exact reachable schema obligations.
2. Maintain deterministic root membership/order from stable semantic identities rather than rebuilding/densifying the entire program after every movement.
3. Incrementally update atom/schema inventories from exact product dependencies.
4. Preserve canonical symbol/function order and byte-identical artifacts.
5. Delete `union_boxed` linear dedup, global executable assembly/repackaging, repeated reached-schema union/cloning, repeated atom walks, and temporary counters once the keyed model owns all consumers.

## Signal

- Unchanged request performs no packaging.
- Unreachable edit changes no root contribution.
- Reached leaf edit evaluates only exact root-reader contributions.
- Adding/removing one reachable executable or schema changes only the corresponding membership and deterministic link projection.
- Same backend/native artifacts and runtime results.
- Full library, fixture matrix, cross-process determinism, formatting, and strict clippy pass.

## Required data-model predecessor and exact remaining contract

fz-tfn.44 atomically establishes stable typed executable/construction references and immutable shared consumer-ready backend members, deleting root-relative body remapping and duplicate SymbolicBackend-to-Backend conversion. Native linking and canonical display may project local ordinals; those ordinals cannot control semantic identities. This is a dependency, not a reduced acceptance condition for .18.

After .44, .18 must still make exact rooted membership and all executable/wrapper/atom/schema contributions react to moved edges. Do not scan every retained ProductMemo entry: historical/unrequested products remain cached. Do not use naive incoming-edge reference counts: an unreachable recursive cycle can retain itself. Derive rooted withdrawal from the actual retained dependency authority without a parallel graph cache or private cone.

Immutable root snapshots require structurally shared collection updates. Rc<HashMap> copy-on-write that clones an entire map while older products retain it does not satisfy changed-key-only work. Select the minimal sound immutable collection/contribution model from evidence; no speculative extra substrate ticket is authorized without a demonstrated prerequisite.

Required additional REDs: reached leaf edit retains sibling contribution allocation/generation; adding/removing one executable/wrapper/atom/schema changes only its exact contributors/readers; removing the sole root edge into a recursive component withdraws the entire unreachable component. Unchanged request and unrelated edit perform no packaging. Existing atom order is first occurrence over semantic-ordered executable bodies: preserve the artifact's required deterministic link projection without redoing per-body extraction.

## Approved implementation model (2026-09-05)

Goal: changed-member-only rooted packaging with immutable shared snapshots. Signal: exact product evaluations/generations, collection path sharing, rooted dependency changes, artifact bytes and runtime results.

1. Delete the proven-unused MaterializedTransportPlan root artifact, RootBackendProductAnswer wrapper and RootBackendContent projection. RootBackendProduct directly owns Rc<BackendProgram>; native and macro consumers read it. Transport tests inspect exact ABI, owner and position answers, without a replacement aggregate.
2. BackendExecutable records typed membership dependencies in ProductDependencies, separately from value reads. These name local call/positioned-owner executable targets and exact StructSchema products. Membership survives transient displacement/waits and changes only on successful replacement; recursive-group external read union does not rewrite membership.
3. ProductMemo owns root subscription deltas and a derived spanning witness over those actual forward/reverse membership dependencies. No copied adjacency, historical memo census, all-member root read replay, naive cycle refcount or private compiler loop. Witness-edge removal detaches the affected witness subtree; exact incoming edges from retained root membership restore alternate paths. An isolated recursive component withdraws entirely.
4. Structurally shared Rc-node ordered trees update only changed paths. Subtree counts provide rank/nth; SemanticOrd owns executable and wrapper ordering. Old snapshots remain immutable. BackendExecutable extracts its atom sequence once; root atom ownership preserves first occurrence over semantic executable order. Wrapper and schema memberships update from exact contributors.
5. Runtime frames/continuations retain body allocations after boundary lookup so tree ordering does not turn ordinary frame access into repeated logarithmic searches. No per-run flatten/prelink.

RED sequence: randomized persistent-tree insert/remove/rank/nth against a simple test oracle plus path-sharing bounds; memo membership replacement/failed/retried/equal reproduction; cycle cut/alternate entry/reattach; retained root leaf/wrapper/atom/schema exact deltas and unchanged/unrelated work silence. Full library, fixture matrix, runtime/CLI/AOT, deterministic backend/CLIF, docs, formatting and strict clippy gates precede cold adversarial review.

## Clean predecessor baseline

HEAD 2f91336cd983c88c1572f6cbb6cd9cb90d676ac1, cargo build --bin fz2 exit 0. Binary SHA256 75592b6744fad0bdb710d7897135b53e046eac7bc3e4ace854df5c9f1e43132d. Evidence /tmp/fz-tfn18-before.gYMdh6 contains range/predicate/take-drop backend, CLIF, interp/native output and telemetry. All six doors exited 0 with expected outputs; backend and CLIF match predecessor .44 evidence. No historical worktree or unrelated files were modified.

Root owns commit/close/push after fresh cold adversarial review; implementation remains one .18 ticket with its full scope.

## TDD evidence in progress

Existing-model RED: reached_leaf_edit_preserves_unchanged_root_atom_allocations runs both interpreter requests correctly (1 then 2), retains the old root snapshot, and fails because untouched sibling :retained_atom changes string allocation. cargo test --lib reached_leaf_edit_preserves_unchanged_root_atom_allocations -- --nocapture: 1 failed, exit 101, before production packaging changes.

SharedOrder RED: missing API compilation failure exit 101. GREEN after Rc-node AVL implementation: cargo test --lib shared_order::tests -- --nocapture: 3 passed, exit 0. Covers 4000 deterministic randomized insert/remove operations against BTreeMap, rank/nth in both directions, reverse comparator authority, equal insert/absent remove preserving root allocation, prior snapshots and bounded branch copying.

Integration checkpoint: root membership is committed per ProductMemo entry, separate from shared recursive value-read dependencies; immutable root contributions use SharedOrder path-copy AVL inventories. RootBackendContent, RootBackendProductAnswer, MaterializedTransportPlan, synthetic CodegenSeam/Fact/Repr inventory removed. Runtime frames/resumes/parks now retain body Rc directly after typed boundary lookup. cargo check --lib GREEN exit0; focused lib test compilation still integrating test APIs (no final green claim). Remaining required work: exact same-body atom/wrapper reconciliation and first-owner canonical atom allocation, transactional lifecycle/equal-refresh/seed tests, deterministic witness repair work, rotated-tree pointer-aware equality work bounds, removal of whole-root boxed calling-convention validator via exact contributions, full gates and cold review. Removed obsolete synthetic-seam tests root_carrier_seam_forces_value_ref_for_a_raw_capable_lane and callable_boundary_seams_preserve_capture_and_argument_carrier_provenance: actual physical_layout_contract carrier coverage remains and transport contracts now assert emitted ABI endpoint/wrapper capture representations, including raw float versus boxed target capture. No scope is deferred.

Further TDD integration evidence: original reached_leaf_edit_preserves_unchanged_root_atom_allocations now GREEN (9973). Rooted lifecycle RED58854 exposed native stale traversal bypassing rooted demand; corrected shared traversal/visit guard and clean fast path; focused rooted GREEN11 including randomized1200 exact net deltas, cycle repair, equal member no packaging telemetry, waiting/abort/rejected recursive completion, seed replacement (RED1727), mixed-cycle termination and zero-capacity clean lookup. Canonical atom transfer/root-vs-body occurrence swap RED67272 fixed via retaining current canonical names for the exact changed transaction; five contribution tests GREEN21699. Inline-lambda real samebody fixture exposed unchanged pre-packaging generated-function stable-label registration panic; parent recorded separately as approved tail fz-tfn.45 and authorized named &leaf reference for .18 stable-identity wrapper allocation proof. Schema-edit integration test diagnosis ongoing, no omission authorized. Whole-root boxed calling-convention verifier now removed in favor of exact executable caller requirements plus unique wrapper publications in shared per-arity contracts; existing negative/agreement contract preserved. Broad library integration run in progress, no final gate/freeze claim.

Current focused proofs: rooted14 cases including full committed multi-owner edge swap, deterministic insertion-order witness/repair work, observable root/native readiness false/true movement with unchanged revisions; persistent tree4 including4095-node rotation work bounds; contribution8 GREEN2916; product-drive38 GREEN28364; real recursive cut/reattach GREEN91460 retains both original recursive backend Rc snapshots using a separately published stable module. Same-body namedref fixture includes its unchanged leaf definition in both valid source-local submissions. Schema proof split: real Compiler2 leaf edit retains schema allocations with zero schema evaluations; actual World.define_struct_def + ExecutionContext.with_product_sessions completion publishes changed StructDefined through retained session authority and moves only the exact schema product. Appending duplicate defmodule source was not a changed-fact stimulus (world schema/revision stayed unchanged), so no unsupported source-redefinition behavior is assumed. Macro-content regression RED77786+refresh RED14038 fixed by a shared unsettled-input predicate and root-aware Refresh derivation; macro GREEN34839. Source/compiler diagnostics and artifact compiler invariants were retained. Parent representative snapshot binary9693ae... produced byte-identical three backend+CLIF pairs and all6 expected interp/native outcomes; final binary revalidation pending after scoped equal-atom lookup optimization. Full library exploratory98352 had1864pass8fail6existingignored; all failures fixed or last two exact emitted-contract test selections under active repair, final sourcefreeze gates still pending.
title: Make root backend packaging react to exact keyed contributions
